messages:
jeff: I'm opening a small quickstart overhaul PR to trim the Hello World to a tiny single-file example, harmonize env vars to RW_API_KEY, and add a minimal local Docker run snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501. Can docs/devex glance today?
nina: happy to review. Can we make curl-first so folks can smoke test without installing anything? Then show Node/Python examples using the new SDK init.
pat: I'll update the Go sample to use redwood.New(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv(\"RW_API_KEY\")}). Also will add a 1-line migration note mapping OLD_RED_KEY -> RW_API_KEY.
jeff: great. Minimal curl example I'm proposing:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood/1.0","input":"Hello world"}'
```
nina: tiny docs nits: 1) include export RW_API_KEY=... example, 2) mention Console -> Settings -> API Tokens path for copying keys, 3) footnote for EU customers to use api.redwood.eu host.
docs-bot: Reminder: add a non-SDK curl example per docs style guide.
pat: pushed Go + Node fixes. Node snippet needs await on client.generate to avoid early exit; updated accordingly.
jeff: adding a 3-line Dockerfile (FROM node:18, copy, CMD node index.js) and run example: docker build -t rw-hello . && docker run -e RW_API_KEY=$RW_API_KEY rw-hello. Keeping it intentionally minimal.
nina: also noticed a broken link to /docs/auth/setup after the nav move. I filed a redirect and updated the link in the PR.
pat: suggestion: add an optional GH Action that lints snippets (node --check, python -m py_compile, go vet) gated by SNIPPET_CI secret so it doesn't run everywhere. I'll add a workflow file.
jeff: sounds good. Once CI is green I'll merge and post a short note in #onboarding about the env rename and the tiny Docker quickstart. :thumbsup:
